note: Document type codes of the invoice type code BT-3 (UNTDID 1001 subset). 380 commercial invoice, 381 credit note. The invoice kind CREDIT_NOTE of sales_invoice has the journal document type AR_CREDIT. Units need no mapping: ref_unit codes follow UN/ECE Recommendation 20 (10, 3.1). Payment means codes are stored directly on company_bank_account (12, 9.2). VAT category and exemption reason are attributes of the tax code version (12, 9.2), not mapped here
